payload.title: Prove repeated real fit-business autonomy and migration readiness
payload.goal: Qualify autonomous observation-to-next-decision behavior separately from commission success.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Require exact-source independent reviewer and product/source/fault receipts before any real cycle.

Cycle 1 observes actual primary-source status and permitted aggregate use, decides admitted source/guide improvement, releases one reviewed useful correction or source-backed page and verifies receiving URL.

Cycle 2 starts from next due/new real evidence without owner launch, evaluates source/usefulness result and completes a second justified real eligible action with receiving-system verification and next decision. A durable no-action wait is valid operation but cannot complete the two-cycle runtime acceptance.

Exercise owner focus French-curve direction, pause pending affiliate effect, answer a missing-input question and crash after release submission; recover original receipt and acknowledge consumed revision.

Prove Windows with Mac disconnected; optional R730 SH-16 migration requires one restored store, stopped/fenced former owner, equivalent receipts and unchanged budgets. No i9/cloud billing prerequisite.

Qualify affiliate/commission and support capabilities separately when gates resolve; real receipts are required and missing sales never block honest completion of an inconclusive usefulness experiment.
tests: Two consecutive completed real cycle IDs each link observation, decision, eligible action, receiving-system verification, evaluation and next decision; waiting or synthetic action cannot replace either real cycle.
Two real permitted external product effects are exercised; synthetic traffic, invented model measurements and test commissions never count as demand.
All A01-A18 mission integration tests and independent source review bind exact commit/artifact.
Unavailable program/support authority remains disabled with executable resume tasks; runtime acceptance names the enabled capability set.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: Autonomous-operation claim is supported for exercised source/product/measurement routes with restart and owner-direction proof.
Financial validation is claimed only from real approved/reversed/paid/cash evidence; helpful launch does not imply revenue.
payload.rollback: Withdraw unsupported capability acceptance, pause new effects and retain useful product under existing owner.
payload.next_eligible_action: Prepare exact-source acceptance protocol and a permitted non-spending source/product cycle.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Real evidence timing and eligible destination access determine elapsed acceptance window.
